ContaboBearerCredential.title: Contabo Bearer Token
ContaboBearerCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing Contabo access token authorized for the required compute GETs. Contabo's documented password grant uses four separate credentials; this node does not exchange, refresh or mint tokens. Replace an expired token manually. Connection reads protected instance metadata and proves scoped resource reachability, not principal/customer identity. The optional expected instance is an existing resource witness.
